preconditions.description: The integer n is between 1 and 50 inclusive.
The integer k is at least 1.
The integer k does not exceed 10^18 or the total count of valid permutations of length n.
The input contains exactly two integers separated by whitespace.

postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly n space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: sorted([int(x) for x in output_tokens]) == list(range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The output integers form a valid permutation of numbers from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: is_self_consistent_permutation([int(x) for x in output_tokens], n)
postconditions.description: The output permutation is invariant under the standard cyclic representation transformation (dropping parentheses yields the same sequence).

postconditions.expression: is_kth_lexicographic([int(x) for x in output_tokens], n, k)
postconditions.description: The output permutation is the k-th permutation in lexicographic order among all permutations of length n that satisfy the self-consistency property.
